ko.title: [농업 101 #3] 흙은 그냥 먼지가 아니다: 발밑에 숨겨진 4층 구조의 기계

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > 토양은 광물 입자, 유기물, 물, 공기로 이루어진 살아있는 층상 구조이며, 그 질감, 구조, 화학적 성질에 따라 씨앗이 수확으로 이어질지 실패로 끝날지가 결정됩니다.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: 아이오와의 뒷마당이나 브루클린의 상자 텃밭에서 흙을 한 움큼 쥐어보세요.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: 그저 갈색 물질처럼 보일 것입니다.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: 하지만 실제로는 네 가지 요소로 이루어진 시스템이며, 건강한 표토는 대략 다음과 같이 구성되어 있습니다.

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% 광물 입자** — 잘게 부서진 암석

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% 유기물** — 죽은 식물, 뿌리, 미생물 및 이들이 변해서 된 부식질

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: 마지막 숫자는 사람들을 놀라게 하곤 합니다.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: 좋은 토양의 4분의 1은 *공기로 가득 찬 빈 공간*입니다.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: 뿌리도 숨을 쉽니다.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: 그 공기를 물로 채워버리면 식물은 질식하게 되는데, 물이 고인 논밭에서 일어나는 일이 바로 이것입니다.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **토성(Texture): 세 가지 입자의 레시피.** 토양학자들은 광물 입자를 크기에 따라 세 가지 클래스로 분류합니다.

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: 이 세 가지의 비율이 바로 **토성(토양 질감)**이며, 이는 본질적으로 영구적입니다. 점토밭을 모래밭으로 바꾸기 위해 트럭으로 모래를 실어 나를 수는 없기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: 토성은 12개 클래스를 정의하는 USDA 토성 삼각도(soil textural triangle)를 통해 읽을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: 농업적으로 가장 유명한 것은 **양토(loam)**(대략 모래 40%, 미사 40%, 점토 20%)로, 배수가 잘될 만큼의 모래와 물 및 양분을 머금을 만큼의 점토가 섞여 있습니다.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: 입자 크기가 왜 그렇게 중요할까요?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: 바로 **표면적** 때문입니다. 모래 1g의 표면적은 수백 제곱센티미터에 불과합니다.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: 반면 점토 1g의 표면적은 수백 *제곱미터*에 달합니다.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: 양분은 입자 표면에 달라붙기 때문에 점토는 양분과 물을 잘 머금고, 모래는 둘 다 그대로 흘려보냅니다.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **토양 구조(Structure): 입자들이 뭉치는 방식.** 토성이 재료라면, **구조**는 그 재료들이 어떻게 조립되어 있는가입니다.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: 입자들은 유기물, 균사, 미생물 분비물에 의해 서로 달라붙어 **입단(aggregates 또는 peds)**이라고 불리는 덩어리를 형성합니다.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: 코티지치즈처럼 잘 부스러지는 좋은 구조는 두 가지 크기의 공극(틈새)을 동시에 만들어냅니다. 배수가 잘되고 공기가 통하는 큰 공극과, 뿌리를 위해 물을 머금는 작은 공극입니다.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: 구조는 취약합니다.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: 젖은 땅 위로 무거운 트랙터를 몰고 가면 구조가 으스러져 **토양 압축(compaction)**이 일어나며, 압축된 토양은 뿌리의 뻗어 나감과 빗물의 흡수를 모두 방해합니다.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **토양 단면: 층 읽기.** 구덩이를 파보면 위에서부터 다음과 같이 표시되는 **토양층(horizons)**을 볼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **O층 (유기물층)** — 낙엽이나 잔재물 등의 표면 유기물 (경작지에서는 얇거나 없음)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **A층 (표토)** — 유기물이 풍부하고 어두운 색을 띠며, 대부분의 뿌리와 생물이 살아가는 곳. 보통 깊이가 15–25 cm에 불과함.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **E층 (용탈층)** — 점토와 광물이 아래로 쓸려 내려가 색이 바랜 밝은 층 (모든 토양에 존재하는 것은 아님)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **B층 (심토)** — 집적층. 위에서 쓸려 내려온 점토와 광물이 모이는 곳. 더 조밀하고 색이 밝음.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **C층 (모재층)** — 풍화된 모재, 거의 변하지 않은 암석 파편

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **R층 (기반암)** — 단단한 암반

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: 가장 위의 A층(표토)이 승부의 전부입니다.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: 이 표토가 몇 센티미터 쌓이는 데는 수백 년이 걸리지만, 맨땅에 심한 폭풍우가 한 번 몰아치면 순식간에 강으로 쓸려 내려가 버립니다.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **화학: pH와 양분의 상호작용.** 두 가지 화학적 성질이 지배적인 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **토양 pH**는 0–14의 범위를 가지며, 대부분의 작물은 6.0–7.0을 선호합니다.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: 그 이유는 식물이 산성을 싫어해서가 아니라, pH가 양분의 *유효도(availability)*를 결정하기 때문입니다.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: 약 5.5 이하의 산성 토양에서는 인이 철 및 알루미늄과 결합하여 굳어버리고, 알루미늄 자체가 용해되어 뿌리에 독성을 나타냅니다.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: 7.5 이상이 되면 철, 아연, 망간을 흡수할 수 없게 됩니다. 알칼리성 토양의 식물이 철분이 물리적으로 바로 옆에 존재하는데도 잎맥 사이가 노랗게 변하는 이유가 바로 이 때문입니다.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: 농부들은 농업용 석회로 pH를 높이고, 원소 유황으로 pH를 낮춥니다.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **양이온 교환 용량(CEC)**은 토양의 양분 저장 배터리입니다.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: 점토 입자와 부식질은 표면에 음전하를 띠고 있어, 양전하를 띤 양분(칼슘, 마그네슘, 칼륨, 암모늄)을 붙잡아 두었다가 뿌리가 필요로 할 때 방출합니다.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: CEC는 kg당 전하의 센티몰(meq/100g 또는 cmolc/kg) 단위로 측정됩니다.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: 모래 토양은 3 정도일 수 있고, 점토와 부식질이 풍부한 토양은 25 이상일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: CEC가 높다는 것은 비료가 유실되지 않고 잘 유지된다는 것을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: CEC가 낮으면 다음 비가 올 때 비료가 씻겨 내려가므로, 모래밭에는 비료를 한 번에 많이 주기보다 적은 양을 자주 주어야 합니다.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: 뉴저지 해안가의 잔디밭과 오하이오 중부의 잔디밭의 차이를 생각해 보세요.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: 뉴저지 해변의 잔디밭은 모래 토양 위에 있습니다.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: 폭우가 쏟아진 지 몇 분 만에 물이 사라져 버리기 때문에, 건조한 날씨가 일주일만 지속되어도 잔디가 갈색으로 변합니다.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: CEC가 낮기 때문에 집주인이 40달러짜리 잔디 비료 한 포대를 뿌리면 2주 동안은 짙은 녹색을 띠다가 이내 시들어 버립니다. 질소의 대부분이 뿌리 아래로 씻겨 내려갔기 때문입니다.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: 해결책은 비료를 더 주는 것이 아니라 *더 많은 유기물*을 주는 것입니다. 퇴비는 보수력(물 보유 능력)과 CEC를 모두 높여주는데, 부식질은 토양에서 CEC가 가장 높은 물질 중 하나이기 때문입니다.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: 오하이오의 잔디밭은 무거운 식양토(clay-loam) 위에 있습니다.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: 여기서는 정반대의 문제가 발생합니다.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: 비가 온 후에는 공극이 작고 배수가 느려 물웅덩이가 하루 동안 고여 있습니다.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: 물에 젖어 있을 때 그 위를 걸으면 토양이 압축되어 구조가 파괴되고, 뿌리가 뚫고 들어갈 수 없는 단단한 다짐층(hardpan)이 만들어집니다.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: 8월이 되면 가문 호수 바닥처럼 갈라집니다.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: 이 경우의 해결책 역시 유기물이지만, 정반대의 이유에서입니다.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: 부식질은 점토 입자들을 뭉쳐 입단 구조를 만들어 주며, 이를 통해 점토 토양에 부족한 큰 공극을 열어줍니다.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: 동일한 개량제를 쓰지만 두 가지 다른 메커니즘이 작동하는 것입니다.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: 이것이 바로 토성과 토양 구조의 차이를 이해할 때 얻을 수 있는 실질적인 이점입니다. 토성은 물려받아 그에 맞춰 관리해야 하는 영역인 반면, 구조는 실제로 우리가 만들거나 파괴할 수 있는 영역입니다.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: 일상적인 결과가 한 가지 더 있습니다.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: 지역 농업기술센터에 의뢰한 토양 검사 결과지가 나오면, 이제 여러분이 알아볼 수 있는 세 가지 항목인 토성 클래스, pH, CEC(종종 유기물 함량 비율과 함께)가 표시되어 있을 것입니다.

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: 미국에서 일반적인 검사 비용은 대략 $15–30 정도입니다.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: 석회를 얼마나 주어야 하는지, 각 양분을 얼마나 주어야 하는지에 대한 추천 처방전은 거의 전적으로 이 수치들을 바탕으로 작성됩니다.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: 토양 검사는 형식적인 절차가 아닙니다. 그것은 작물에 영양을 공급하느냐, 아니면 인근 수계에 오염 물질을 쏟아붓느냐의 차이를 만듭니다.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3줄 정리

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. 토양은 약 45%의 광물, 5%의 유기물, 25%의 물, 25%의 공기로 구성되어 있으며, 뿌리도 호흡을 하기 때문에 공기는 필수적입니다.

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. **토성**(고정된 모래-미사-점토 비율)은 토양의 한계를 설정하고, **토양 구조**(입자들이 뭉치는 방식)는 관리를 통해 개선하거나 파괴할 수 있는 영역이며, A층부터 기반암까지의 단면층은 물과 양분이 이동하는 경로를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. **pH**는 양분이 화학적으로 흡수 가능한 상태인지를 지배하고, **CEC**는 토양이 양분을 얼마나 머금을 수 있는지를 결정합니다. 따라서 CEC를 높이고 구조를 동시에 개선하는 유기물은 농지에서 가장 가치 있는 단 하나의 물질입니다.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **Q1.** 농장 관리로 실질적으로 바꿀 수 없는, 본질적으로 영구적인 토양의 성질은 무엇인가요?

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) 토양 구조 (Soil structure)

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) 토성 (Soil texture)

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) 토양 pH (Soil pH)

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) 양이온 교환 용량 (Cation exchange capacity)

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **Q2.** 한 농부의 작물 잎맥 사이가 노랗게 변하는 현상(철 결핍 증상)이 나타났으나, 토양 검사 결과 토양 자체에는 철분이 충분한 것으로 나타났습니다.

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: 가장 가능성 높은 원인은 무엇일까요?

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) 토양 pH가 너무 높아(알칼리성) 철분을 흡수할 수 없음

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) 토양에 유기물이 너무 많음

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) A층(표토)이 너무 깊음

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) 토성이 너무 모래질임

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **Q3.** O/X: 건강한 표토에서 부피의 대략 절반은 물과 공기로 채워진 공극 공간입니다.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **토성 (Soil texture)** — 토양 내 모래, 미사, 점토 입자의 상대적인 비율. 양토나 식질점토와 같은 토성 클래스를 분류하는 데 사용되는 고정된 성질입니다.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **토양 구조 (Soil structure)** — 개별 입자들이 어떻게 뭉쳐서 입단(peds)을 형성하는가에 대한 것으로, 공극의 크기, 배수, 통기성을 결정합니다. 토성과 달리 관리를 통해 개선하거나 파괴할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **토양층 (Soil horizon)** — 풍화 작용과 물 및 물질의 하향 이동으로 인해 토양 단면에 형성된 뚜렷한 층들 (O, A, E, B, C, R).

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **토양 pH (Soil pH)** — 양분의 화학적 유효도를 결정하는 토양의 산도 또는 알칼리도 측정값. 대부분의 작물은 약 6.0에서 7.0 사이에서 가장 잘 자랍니다.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **양이온 교환 용량 (CEC)** — 점토와 부식질의 음전하 표면에 교환 가능한 양전하 양분을 붙잡아 둘 수 있는 토양의 능력. CEC가 높을수록 양분 보유력이 좋습니다.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *정답: **Q1 — B.** 토성은 모재로부터 물려받은 광물 입자의 크기에 의해 결정되므로, 이를 바꾸려면 물리적으로 엄청난 양의 흙을 교체해야 합니다.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: 반면 구조, pH, CEC는 경운, 석회 시용, 유기물 투입 등을 통해 변화시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** pH가 대략 7.5 이상이 되면 철분이 식물이 흡수할 수 없는 형태로 변하므로, 이는 양의 문제가 아니라 유효도의 문제입니다. 이를 석회 유도 황화현상(lime-induced chlorosis)이라고 합니다.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — O.** 물 약 25%와 공기 약 25%는 부피의 대략 절반이 공극 공간임을 의미합니다. 정확한 비율은 토양이 젖고 마름에 따라 끊임없이 변하지만, 토양이 압축되지 않는 한 전체 공극 공간은 거의 일정하게 유지됩니다.*

zh.title: [Agriculture 101 #3] 泥土不是土壤：你脚下的四层机器

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > 土壤是由矿物质颗粒、有机物、水和空气组成的有生命的、分层的结构——它的质地、结构和化学性质决定了种子是迎来丰收还是走向失败。

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: 抓一把爱荷华州后院或布鲁克林高架花坛里的土壤。

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: 它看起来像棕色的东西。

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: 它实际上是一个四部分组成的系统，健康的表层土大约包含：

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% 矿物质颗粒** — 粉碎的岩石

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% 有机物** — 死亡的植物、根系、微生物以及它们转化而成的腐殖质

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: 最后一个数字让人感到意外。

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: 优质土壤中有四分之一是*充满空气的空隙*。

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: 根系需要呼吸。

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: 排挤掉这些空气，植物就会窒息，这正是涝灾田中发生的情况。

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **质地：三种颗粒的配方。** 土壤科学家根据大小将矿物质颗粒分为三类：

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: 这三种成分的比例就是**土壤质地**，它基本上是永久性的——你无法运来足够的沙子来改变一片黏土地。

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: 质地可以通过美国农业部（USDA）土壤质地三角形来读取，其中划分了 12 个类别。

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: 农业中最著名的是**壤土**（大约 40% 沙粒、40% 粉粒、20% 黏粒）：既有足够的沙子来排水，又有足够的黏粒来保持水分和养分。

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: 为什么颗粒大小如此重要？

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **表面积。** 一克沙子只有几百平方厘米的表面积。

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: 而一克黏土则拥有数*平方米*的表面积。

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: 养分会附着在颗粒表面，因此黏土能锁住养分和水分；而沙子则会让两者直接流失。

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **结构：颗粒如何团聚。** 质地是成分；**结构**是它们的组装方式。

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: 颗粒结合成被称为**团聚体**或**土块**的小块，由有机物、真菌菌丝和微生物分泌物胶结在一起。

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: 良好的结构——呈碎屑状、像干酪一样——同时创造了两种孔隙大小：排水和透气的大孔隙，以及为根系保持水分的小孔隙。

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: 结构是脆弱的。

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: 在潮湿的地面上开着重型拖拉机会将其压实造成**土壤压实**，而压实的土壤既抗拒根系也抗拒降雨。

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **土壤剖面：阅读土层。** 挖一个坑，你会看到从顶部开始标记的**发生层**：

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **O 层** — 地表枯枝落叶、树叶和残留物（在耕作农田中较薄或不存在）

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **A 层** — 表层土。颜色深、富含有机物，绝大多数根系和生物栖息于此。通常深度仅有 15–25 厘米。

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **E 层** — 淋溶层，颜色较浅，黏土和矿物质向下流失（并非所有土壤都有）

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **B 层** — 心土层。富集带，从上方冲刷下来的黏土和矿物质在此汇集。密度更高，颜色更浅。

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **C 层** — 风化母质，几乎未改变的岩石碎块

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **R 层** — 基岩

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: 顶部的 A 层最为关键。

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: 建立几厘米厚的 A 层需要几个世纪，而在裸露的土地上经历一场恶劣的风暴就足以将其冲进河流。

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **化学性质：pH 值与养分握手。** 两种化学性质起主导作用。

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **土壤 pH 值**范围为 0–14，大多数作物喜欢 6.0–7.0。

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: 原因并不是植物不喜欢酸——而是 pH 值控制着养分的*有效性*。

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: 在低于约 5.5 的酸性土壤中，磷与铁和铝结合固定，铝本身也变得足够可溶以至于毒害根系。

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: 高于 7.5 时，铁、锌和锰变得不可给给植物利用，这就是为什么在碱性土壤中，尽管铁就在那里，植物的叶脉之间仍然会发黄。

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: 农民用农业石灰提高 pH 值，用元素硫降低 pH 值。

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **阳离子交换量（CEC）**是土壤的养分储能电池。

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: 黏土颗粒和腐殖质带有负表面电荷，因此它们可以保持带正电荷的养分——钙、镁、钾、铵——并根据需求将其释放给根系。

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: CEC 以每公斤电荷的厘摩尔（centimoles）来衡量。

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: 沙质土壤的 CEC 可能为 3；而黏土和腐殖质土壤则在 25 或更高。

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: 高 CEC 意味着肥料不会流失。

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: 低 CEC 意味着它会在下一场雨中被冲走，这就是为什么沙质田地需要分小剂量、频繁施肥，而不是一次性大量施肥。

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: 想想新泽西州沿海草坪与俄亥俄州中部草坪的区别。

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: 泽西海岸的草坪位于沙质土壤上。

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: 暴雨过后几分钟水就消失了，因此在干燥天气的一周内草坪就会变黄。

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: CEC 很低，因此房主撒了一袋 40 美元的草坪肥料，获得了两周的深绿色，然后看着它褪色——大部分氮肥都被冲到了根系区以下。

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: 解决方法不是更多的肥料，而是*更多的有机物*：堆肥既能提高保水能力又能提高 CEC，因为腐殖质是土壤中 CEC 最高的材料之一。

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: 俄亥俄州的草坪位于重黏壤土上。

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: 相反的问题。

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: 雨后，水坑会持续一天，因为孔隙很小且排水缓慢。

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: 在浸透时在上面行走会将其压实，破坏结构并形成根系无法穿透的硬底层。

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: 到了八月，它会像干燥的湖床一样龟裂。

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: 这里的解决方法也是有机物——但原因恰好相反。

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: 腐殖质将黏土颗粒结合成团聚体，从而打开了黏土缺乏的大孔隙。

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: 相同的改良剂，两种不同的机制。

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: 这就是理解质地与结构之间的实际回报：质地是你继承并需要适应的，而结构则是你实际上可以建立或破坏的。

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: 还有一个日常影响。

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: 当你的县推广办公室的土壤测试结果出来时，它报告了你现在认出的三件事：质地类别、pH 值和 CEC（通常还有有机物百分比）。

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: 在美国，典型的测试费用大约为 15–30 美元。

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: 建议表——需要多少石灰、每种养分需要多少——几乎完全由这些数字生成。

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: 土壤测试不是一种形式；它是喂养作物与喂养分水岭之间的区别。

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3줄 정리

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. 土壤大约由 45% 的矿物质、5% 的有机物、25% 的水和 25% 的空气组成——空气不是可选的，因为根系需要呼吸。

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. **质地**（固定的沙-粉-黏比例）设定了土壤的上限；**结构**（颗粒如何团聚）是管理所能建立或压碎的东西，从 A 层一直到基岩的分层剖面展示了水和养分的流动路径。

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. **pH 值**决定了养分是否在化学上可用，而 **CEC** 决定了土壤能容纳其中多少养分——这就是为什么能同时提高 CEC 并改善结构的有机物是田中最高贵的东西。

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **Q1.** 哪种土壤性质基本上是永久性的，无法通过农业管理实际改变？

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) 土壤结构

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) 土壤质地

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) 土壤 pH 值

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) 阳离子交换量

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **Q2.** 农民的作物表现出叶脉间发黄（缺铁症状），但土壤测试显示存在大量铁。

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: 最可能的原因是什么？

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) 土壤 pH 值太高（碱性），使得铁不可用

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) 土壤有机物过多

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) A 层太深

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) 土壤质地太沙质

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **Q3.** 判断题：在健康的表层土中，大约有一半的体积是被水和空气填满的孔隙空间。

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **Soil texture（土壤质地）** — 土壤中沙粒、粉粒和黏粒的相对比例；用于指定壤土或粉砂黏土等质地类别的固定属性。

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **Soil structure（土壤结构）** — 个别颗粒如何结合成团聚体（土块），决定了孔隙大小、排水和通气性；与质地不同，它可以通过管理来建立或破坏。

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **Soil horizon（土壤发生层）** — 土壤剖面中的一个独特层（O、A、E、B、C、R），由风化以及水和物质的向下运动形成。

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **Soil pH（土壤酸碱度）** — 衡量土壤酸碱度的指标，控制着养分的化学有效性；大多数作物在 6.0 到 7.0 之间表现最好。

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)（阳离子交换量）** — 土壤在黏土和腐殖质的负表面上容纳可交换正电荷养分的能力；更高的 CEC 意味着更好的养分保留能力。

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *答案：**Q1 — B。** 质地是由母质继承的矿物质颗粒大小决定的；改变它需要物理更换巨量的土壤。

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: 结构、pH 值和 CEC 都可以通过耕作、石灰和有机物来改变。

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A。** 大约在 pH 7.5 以上，铁转化为植物无法吸收的形式，因此缺乏的是有效性而不是数量——这被称为石灰诱导的失绿症。

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — O。** 大约 25% 的水加上 25% 的空气意味着大约一半的体积是孔隙空间；随着土壤湿润和排水，具体的比例会不断变化，但除非土壤被压实，否则总孔隙空间保持大致相同。*

hi.title: [कृषि 101 #3] मिट्टी सिर्फ़ 'धूल' नहीं है: आपके पैरों के नीचे की चार-परत वाली मशीन

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > मिट्टी खनिज कणों, जैविक पदार्थों, पानी और हवा से बनी एक जीवित, स्तरित संरचना है — और इसकी बनावट (texture), संरचना (structure) और रसायन शास्त्र यह तय करते हैं कि एक बीज फसल बनता है या विफल होता है।

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## मुख्य अवधारणा

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: आयोवा के किसी पिछले आँगन से या ब्रुकलिन के एक उभरे हुए क्यारी (raised bed) से एक मुट्ठी मिट्टी उठाएँ।

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: यह भूरे रंग की सामग्री जैसी दिखती है।

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: यह वास्तव में एक चार-भाग प्रणाली है, और एक स्वस्थ ऊपरी मिट्टी (topsoil) लगभग ऐसी होती है:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% खनिज कण** — पिसी हुई चट्टान

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% जैविक पदार्थ** — मृत पौधे, जड़ें, सूक्ष्मजीव और उनसे बनने वाला ह्यूमस

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: यह आखिरी संख्या लोगों को हैरान करती है।

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: अच्छी मिट्टी का एक चौथाई हिस्सा *हवा से भरी खाली जगह* होती है।

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: जड़ें सांस लेती हैं।

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: उस हवा को पानी से बाहर निकाल दें तो पौधा घुट जाता है, जो जलभराव वाले खेत में बिल्कुल ऐसा ही होता है।

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **बनावट (Texture): तीन-कणों का नुस्खा।** मिट्टी के वैज्ञानिक आकार के आधार पर खनिज कणों को तीन श्रेणियों में छांटते हैं:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: इन तीनों का अनुपात **मिट्टी की बनावट (soil texture)** है, और यह अनिवार्य रूप से स्थायी है — आप क्ले वाले खेत को बदलने के लिए पर्याप्त रेत ट्रकों से नहीं ला सकते।

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: बनावट को USDA मृदा बनावट त्रिकोण (soil textural triangle) से पढ़ा जाता है, जो 12 श्रेणियों का नाम देता है।

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: कृषि रूप से सबसे प्रसिद्ध **दोमट (loam)** है (लगभग 40% रेत, 40% गाद (silt), 20% क्ले): जल निकासी के लिए पर्याप्त रेत, पानी और पोषक तत्वों को रोके रखने के लिए पर्याप्त क्ले।

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: कण का आकार इतना महत्वपूर्ण क्यों है?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **सतही क्षेत्र (Surface area)।** एक ग्राम रेत की सतह कुछ सौ वर्ग सेंटीमीटर होती है।

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: एक ग्राम क्ले का सतही क्षेत्र सैकड़ों *वर्ग मीटर* होता है।

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: पोषक तत्व कणों की सतहों से चिपके रहते हैं, इसलिए क्ले पोषक तत्वों और पानी को बनाए रखती है; जबकि रेत दोनों को सीधे बह जाने देती है।

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **संरचना (Structure): कण कैसे आपस में जुड़ते हैं।** बनावट सामग्री है; **संरचना** यह है कि उन्हें कैसे जोड़ा गया है।

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: कण जैविक पदार्थों, कवक धागों और सूक्ष्मजीव स्रावों द्वारा एक साथ चिपककर **समुच्चय (aggregates)** या **पेड्स (peds)** नामक ढेलों और ब्लॉकों में बंध जाते हैं।

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: अच्छी संरचना — भुरभुरी, कॉटेज-चीज़ जैसी — एक साथ दो रंध्रीय आकार (pore sizes) बनाती है: बड़े रंध्र जो जल निकासी करते हैं और हवा को आने देते हैं, और छोटे रंध्र जो जड़ों के लिए पानी बनाए रखते हैं।

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: संरचना नाज़ुक होती है।

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: गीली जमीन पर भारी ट्रैक्टर चलाने से यह कुचलकर **सघनता (compaction)** में बदल जाती है, और सघन मिट्टी जड़ों और बारिश दोनों का विरोध करती है।

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **मिट्टी की प्रोफाइल: परतों को पढ़ना।** एक गड्ढा खोदें और आपको **क्षितिज (horizons)** दिखाई देंगे, जिन्हें ऊपर से लेबल किया गया है:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **O क्षितिज** — सतह का कचरा, पत्तियां और अवशेष (जुताई वाली कृषि भूमि में पतली या अनुपस्थित)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **A क्षितिज** — ऊपरी मिट्टी (topsoil)। गहरा, जैविक-समृद्ध, जहाँ अधिकांश जड़ें और जीव रहते हैं। अक्सर केवल 15–25 cm गहरा।

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **E क्षितिज** — एक निक्षालित (leached), पीली परत जहाँ क्ले और खनिज नीचे की ओर बह गए हैं (हर मिट्टी में मौजूद नहीं)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **B क्षितिज** — निचली मिट्टी (subsoil)। संचयन क्षेत्र, जहाँ ऊपर से बहे क्ले और खनिज जमा होते हैं। अधिक घनी, रंग में हल्की।

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **C क्षितिज** — अपक्षयित मूल सामग्री (weathered parent material), नाममात्र परिवर्तित चट्टान के टुकड़े

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **R क्षितिज** — आधार-चट्टान (bedrock)

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: वह ऊपरी A क्षितिज ही खेल का मुख्य हिस्सा है।

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: इसके कुछ सेंटीमीटर बनने में सदियां लग जाती हैं और नंगे खेत में एक खराब तूफान इसे नदी में बहा ले जाने के लिए काफी है।

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **रसायन शास्त्र: pH और पोषक तत्वों का तालमेल।** दो रासायनिक गुण हावी हैं।

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **मिट्टी का pH** 0–14 तक होता है, और अधिकांश फसलें 6.0–7.0 पसंद करती हैं।

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: कारण यह नहीं है कि पौधे अम्ल नापसंद करते हैं — बल्कि pH पोषक तत्वों की *उपलब्धता* को नियंत्रित करता है।

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: लगभग 5.5 से नीचे अम्लीय मिट्टी में, फास्फोरस लोहे और एल्यूमीनियम के साथ बंद हो जाता है, और एल्यूमीनियम स्वयं जड़ों को जहर देने के लिए पर्याप्त घुलनशील हो जाता है।

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: 7.5 से ऊपर, लोहा, जस्ता और मैंगनीज अनुपलब्ध हो जाते हैं, यही वजह है कि क्षारीय मिट्टी में पौधे नसों के बीच पीले पड़ जाते हैं, भले ही लोहा भौतिक रूप से वहीं मौजूद हो।

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: किसान कृषि चूने (lime) के साथ pH बढ़ाते हैं और मौलिक सल्फर के साथ इसे घटाते हैं।

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **धनायन विनिमय क्षमता (CEC)** मिट्टी की पोषक तत्व भंडारण बैटरी है।

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: क्ले कण और ह्यूमस ऋणात्मक सतही आवेश (negative surface charges) ले जाते हैं, इसलिए वे धनात्मक रूप से आवेशित पोषक तत्वों — कैल्शियम, मैग्नीशियम, पोटेशियम, अमोनियम — को बनाए रखते हैं और मांग पर उन्हें जड़ों में छोड़ते हैं।

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: CEC को प्रति किलोग्राम आवेश के सेंटीमोल में मापा जाता है।

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: एक रेतीली मिट्टी 3 पर हो सकती है; एक क्ले-और-ह्यूमस मिट्टी 25 या उससे अधिक पर।

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: उच्च CEC का मतलब है कि उर्वरक बना रहता है।

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: कम CEC का मतलब है कि यह अगली बारिश के साथ निक्षालित (leach) हो जाता है, यही वजह है कि रेतीले खेतों को एक बड़े आवेदन के बजाय कम और बार-बार खुराक में उर्वरित किया जाता है।

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## व्यावहारिक उदाहरण

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: तटीय न्यू जर्सी और मध्य ओहायो के लॉन के बीच अंतर के बारे में सोचें।

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: जर्सी तट का लॉन रेतीली मिट्टी पर स्थित है।

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: मूसलाधार बारिश के कुछ ही मिनटों बाद पानी गायब हो जाता है, इसलिए सूखे मौसम के एक सप्ताह के भीतर घास भूरी हो जाती है।

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: CEC कम है, इसलिए मकान मालिक लॉन उर्वरक की $40 की बोरी फैलाता है, दो सप्ताह के लिए गहरा हरा रंग प्राप्त करता है, और इसे फीका पड़ता देखता है — अधिकांश नाइट्रोजन जड़ क्षेत्र के नीचे बह जाती है।

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: इसका समाधान अधिक उर्वरक नहीं बल्कि *अधिक जैविक पदार्थ* है: कम्पोस्ट जल-धारण क्षमता और CEC दोनों को बढ़ाता है, क्योंकि ह्यूमस मिट्टी में सबसे उच्च-CEC सामग्रियों में से एक है।

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: ओहायो का लॉन भारी क्ले-दोमट पर स्थित है।

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: विपरीत समस्याएं।

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: बारिश के बाद, गड्ढों में पानी एक दिन तक रहता है क्योंकि रंध्र छोटे होते हैं और जल निकासी धीमी होती है।

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: जब यह भीगा हो तब इस पर चलें और आप इसे सघन (compact) कर देते हैं, जिससे संरचना नष्ट हो जाती है और एक कठोर परत बन जाती है जिसे जड़ें पार नहीं करेंगी।

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: अगस्त आते-आते यह सूखी झील के तल की तरह दरार में बदल जाता है।

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: यहाँ भी समाधान जैविक पदार्थ ही है — लेकिन विपरीत कारण से।

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: ह्यूमस क्ले कणों को समुच्चयों (aggregates) में बांधता है, जिससे बड़े रंध्र खुलते हैं जिनकी क्ले मिट्टी में कमी होती है।

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: एक ही संशोधन, दो अलग-अलग तंत्र।

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: बनावट बनाम संरचना को समझने का यही व्यावहारिक लाभ है: बनावट आपको विरासत में मिलती है और आप इसके अनुसार प्रबंधन करते हैं, संरचना को आप वास्तव में बना या नष्ट कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: एक और रोज़मर्रा का परिणाम।

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: जब आपके काउंटी विस्तार कार्यालय से मिट्टी का परीक्षण आता है, तो यह तीन चीजों की रिपोर्ट करता है जिन्हें अब आप पहचानते हैं: बनावट श्रेणी, pH, और CEC (अक्सर जैविक पदार्थ प्रतिशत के साथ)।

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: अमेरिका में एक सामान्य परीक्षण की लागत लगभग $15–30 होती है।

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: अनुशंसा पत्र — कितना चूना, प्रत्येक पोषक तत्व का कितना हिस्सा — लगभग पूरी तरह से उन संख्याओं से उत्पन्न होता है।

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: मिट्टी का परीक्षण कोई औपचारिकता नहीं है; यह फसल को पोषण देने और जलक्षेत्र (watershed) को दूषित करने के बीच का अंतर है।

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. मिट्टी लगभग 45% खनिज, 5% जैविक पदार्थ, 25% पानी और 25% हवा है — और हवा वैकल्पिक नहीं है, क्योंकि जड़ें श्वसन करती हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. **बनावट** (निश्चित रेत-गाद-क्ले अनुपात) मिट्टी की सीमा तय करती है; **संरचना** (कण कैसे इकट्ठा होते हैं) वह है जिसे प्रबंधन बनाता या कुचलता है, और A क्षितिज से आधार-चट्टान तक की स्तरित प्रोफाइल दिखाती है कि पानी और पोषक तत्व कहाँ यात्रा करते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. **pH** यह नियंत्रित करता है कि क्या पोषक तत्व रासायनिक रूप से उपलब्ध हैं, और **CEC** यह नियंत्रित करता है कि मिट्टी उनमें से कितने को धारण कर सकती है — यही कारण है कि जैविक पदार्थ, जो CEC को बढ़ाता है और एक साथ संरचना में सुधार करता है, खेत में सबसे मूल्यवान चीज़ है।

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ स्वयं-परीक्षण

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **Q1.** मिट्टी का कौन सा गुण अनिवार्य रूप से स्थायी है और कृषि प्रबंधन द्वारा व्यावहारिक रूप से नहीं बदला जा सकता है?

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) मिट्टी की संरचना (Soil structure)

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) मिट्टी की बनावट (Soil texture)

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) मिट्टी का pH

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) धनायन विनिमय क्षमता (CEC)

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **Q2.** एक किसान की फसल पत्तियों की नसों के बीच पीलापन (लोहे की कमी के लक्षण) दिखाती है, लेकिन मिट्टी का परीक्षण प्रचुर मात्रा में लोहा मौजूद दिखाता है।

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: सबसे संभावित कारण क्या है?

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) मिट्टी का pH बहुत अधिक (क्षारीय) है, जिससे लोहा अनुपलब्ध हो जाता है

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) मिट्टी में बहुत अधिक जैविक पदार्थ हैं

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) A क्षितिज बहुत गहरा है

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) मिट्टी की बनावट बहुत रेतीली है

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **Q3.** सही/गलत: एक स्वस्थ ऊपरी मिट्टी में, लगभग आधा आयतन पानी और हवा से भरा रंध्र स्थान (pore space) होता है।

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 शब्दावली

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **Soil texture (मिट्टी की बनावट)** — मिट्टी में रेत, गाद और क्ले कणों का सापेक्ष अनुपात; एक निश्चित गुण जिसका उपयोग दोमट या सिल्टी क्ले जैसी बनावट श्रेणी निर्धारित करने के लिए किया जाता है।

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **Soil structure (मिट्टी की संरचना)** — व्यक्तिगत कण समुच्चयों (peds) में कैसे बंधते हैं, जो रंध्र के आकार, जल निकासी और वातन को निर्धारित करता है; बनावट के विपरीत, इसे प्रबंधन द्वारा बनाया या नष्ट किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **Soil horizon (मिट्टी का क्षितिज)** — अपक्षय और पानी तथा सामग्रियों की नीचे की ओर गति से निर्मित मिट्टी की प्रोफाइल (O, A, E, B, C, R) में एक अलग परत।

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **Soil pH (मिट्टी का pH)** — मिट्टी की अम्लता या क्षारीयता का माप जो पोषक तत्वों की रासायनिक उपलब्धता को नियंत्रित करता है; अधिकांश फसलें लगभग 6.0 और 7.0 के बीच सबसे अच्छा प्रदर्शन करती हैं।

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC / धनायन विनिमय क्षमता)** — क्ले और ह्यूमस की ऋणात्मक सतहों पर विनिमय योग्य धनात्मक आवेशित पोषक तत्वों को धारण करने की मिट्टी की क्षमता; उच्च CEC का अर्थ बेहतर पोषक तत्व प्रतिधारण है।

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *उत्तर: **Q1 — B.** बनावट मूल सामग्री से विरासत में मिले खनिज कण आकारों द्वारा निर्धारित होती है; इसे बदलने के लिए भौतिक रूप से मिट्टी की भारी मात्रा को बदलने की आवश्यकता होगी।

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: संरचना, pH और CEC सभी को जुताई, चूने और जैविक पदार्थों द्वारा बदला जा सकता है।

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** लगभग pH 7.5 से ऊपर, लोहा उन रूपों में परिवर्तित हो जाता है जिन्हें पौधे अवशोषित नहीं कर सकते, इसलिए कमी उपलब्धता की है, मात्रा की नहीं — इसे लाइम-प्रेरित क्लोरोसिस (lime-induced chlorosis) कहा जाता है।

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — सही।** लगभग 25% पानी प्लस 25% हवा का मतलब है कि लगभग आधा आयतन रंध्र स्थान है; जैसे-जैसे मिट्टी गीली और सूखी होती है, सटीक विभाजन लगातार बदलता रहता है, लेकिन कुल रंध्र स्थान लगभग समान रहता है जब तक कि मिट्टी सघन न हो।*

es.title: [Agricultura 101 #3] La tierra no es suelo: La máquina de cuatro capas bajo tus pies

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > El suelo es una estructura viva y estratificada compuesta por partículas minerales, materia orgánica, agua y aire; y su textura, estructura y química determinan si una semilla se convierte en una cosecha o en un fracaso.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: Toma un puñado de suelo de un patio trasero en Iowa o de un huerto elevado en Brooklyn.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: Parece una sustancia marrón.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: En realidad, es un sistema de cuatro partes, y una capa superficial del suelo saludable es aproximadamente:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% partículas minerales** — roca molida

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% materia orgánica** — plantas muertas, raíces, microbios y el humus en el que se convierten

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: Ese último número sorprende a la gente.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: Un cuarto de un buen suelo es *espacio vacío lleno de aire*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: Las raíces respiran.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: Si ahogas ese aire, la planta se asfixia, que es exactamente lo que sucede en un campo encharcado.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **Textura: la receta de tres partículas.** Los científicos del suelo clasifican las partículas minerales por tamaño en tres clases:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: La proporción de estas tres es la **textura del suelo**, y es esencialmente permanente; no se puede transportar suficiente arena en camiones para cambiar un campo arcilloso.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: La textura se lee en el triángulo de texturas del suelo del USDA, que nombra 12 clases.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: La más famosa en agricultura es el **franco** (aproximadamente 40% de arena, 40% de limo, 20% de arcilla): suficiente arena para drenar, suficiente arcilla para retener agua y nutrientes.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: ¿Por qué importa tanto el tamaño de las partículas?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **Área superficial.** Un gramo de arena tiene unos pocos cientos de centímetros cuadrados de superficie.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: Un gramo de arcilla tiene cientos de *metros cuadrados*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: Los nutrientes se adhieren a las superficies de las partículas, por lo que la arcilla retiene nutrientes y agua; la arena deja que ambos pasen directamente.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **Estructura: cómo se agrupan las partículas.** La textura son los ingredientes; la **estructura** es cómo se ensamblan.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: Las partículas se unen en grumos y bloques llamados **agregados** o **peds**, pegados por materia orgánica, hilos fúngicos y secreciones microbianas.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: Una buena estructura —desmenuzable, parecida al queso cottage— crea dos tamaños de poros a la vez: poros grandes que drenan y permiten la entrada de aire, y poros pequeños que retienen agua para las raíces.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: La estructura es frágil.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: Conducir un tractor pesado sobre suelo húmedo lo aplasta provocando **compactación**, y el suelo compactado resiste tanto a las raíces como a la lluvia.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **El perfil del suelo: leyendo las capas.** Cavando una fosa se pueden ver los **horizontes**, etiquetados desde la parte superior:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **Horizonte O** — hojarasca superficial, hojas y residuos (delgado o ausente en tierras de cultivo labradas)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte A** — capa superficial del suelo. Oscuro, rico en materia orgánica, donde vive la mayor parte de las raíces y la biología. A menudo tiene solo de 15 a 25 cm de profundidad.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **Horizonte E** — una capa lixiviada y pálida donde la arcilla y los minerales se han lavado hacia abajo (no presente en todos los suelos)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte B** — subsuelo. La zona de acumulación, donde se acumulan la arcilla y los minerales lavados desde arriba. Más denso, de color más claro.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **Horizonte C** — material parental meteorizado, fragmentos de roca apenas alterados

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **Horizonte R** — roca madre

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: Ese horizonte A superior lo es todo.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: Se necesitan siglos para construir unos pocos centímetros de él y una sola tormenta fuerte en suelo desnudo para arrastrarlo a un río.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **Química: el pH y el intercambio de nutrientes.** Dominan dos propiedades químicas.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: El **pH del suelo** va de 0 a 14, y la mayoría de los cultivos prefieren de 6.0 a 7.0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: La razón no es que a las plantas les desagrade el ácido, sino que el pH controla la *disponibilidad* de nutrientes.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: En suelos ácidos por debajo de aproximadamente 5.5, el fósforo se bloquea con el hierro y el aluminio, y el aluminio mismo se vuelve lo suficientemente soluble como para envenenar las raíces.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: Por encima de 7.5, el hierro, el zinc y el manganeso dejan de estar disponibles, razón por la cual las plantas en suelos alcalinos amarillean entre las venas de las hojas, aunque el hierro esté físicamente allí.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: Los agricultores elevan el pH con cal agrícola y lo bajan con azufre elemental.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: La **capacidad de intercambio catiónico (CIC)** es la batería de almacenamiento de nutrientes del suelo.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: Las partículas de arcilla y el humus tienen cargas superficiales negativas, por lo que retienen nutrientes cargados positivamente —calcio, magnesio, potasio, amonio— y los liberan a las raíces según la demanda.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: La CIC se mide en centimoles de carga por kilogramo.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: Un suelo arenoso podría estar en 3; un suelo de arcilla y humus en 25 o más.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: Una CIC alta significa que el fertilizante se queda en su lugar.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: Una CIC baja significa que se lixivia con la próxima lluvia, razón por la cual los campos arenosos se fertilizan en dosis pequeñas y frecuentes en lugar de una sola aplicación grande.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## En la vida cotidiana

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Piensa en la diferencia entre un césped en la costa de Nueva Jersey y uno en el centro de Ohio.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: El césped de la costa de Jersey se asienta sobre un suelo arenoso.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: El agua desaparece minutos después de un aguacero, por lo que el césped se vuelve marrón a la semana de clima seco.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: La CIC es baja, por lo que el propietario esparce una bolsa de fertilizante para césped de $40, obtiene dos semanas de verde intenso y luego ve cómo se desvanece; la mayor parte del nitrógeno se lavó por debajo de la zona de las raíces.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: La solución no es más fertilizante, sino *más materia orgánica*: el compost eleva tanto la capacidad de retención de agua como la CIC, porque el humus es uno de los materiales con mayor CIC en el suelo.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: El césped de Ohio se asienta sobre un franco arcilloso pesado.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: Problemas opuestos.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: Después de la lluvia, los charcos permanecen durante un día porque los poros son pequeños y el drenaje es lento.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: Camina sobre él mientras está empapado y lo compactarás, destruyendo la estructura y creando una capa dura que las raíces no atravesarán.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: Al llegar agosto, se agrieta como el lecho de un lago seco.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: La solución aquí también es la materia orgánica, pero por la razón opuesta.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: El humus une las partículas de arcilla en agregados, lo que abre los poros grandes de los que carece el suelo arcilloso.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: Misma enmienda, dos mecanismos diferentes.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: Ese es el beneficio práctico de entender la textura frente a la estructura: la textura se hereda y se maneja, la estructura realmente se puede construir o destruir.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: Una consecuencia cotidiana más.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: Cuando regresa una prueba de suelo de la oficina de extensión de tu condado, informa tres cosas que ahora reconoces: clase de textura, pH y CIC (a menudo junto con el porcentaje de materia orgánica).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: Una prueba típica cuesta aproximadamente entre $15 y $30 en los EE. UU.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: La hoja de recomendaciones —cuánta cal, cuánto de cada nutriente— se genera casi en su totalidad a partir de esos números.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: Una prueba de suelo no es un trámite; es la diferencia entre alimentar al cultivo y alimentar a la cuenca hidrográfica.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Resumen en 3 líneas

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. El suelo se compone de aproximadamente un 45% de minerales, un 5% de materia orgánica, un 25% de agua y un 25% de aire; y el aire no es opcional, porque las raíces respiran.

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. La **textura** (la proporción fija de arena-limo-arcilla) establece el límite máximo de un suelo; la **estructura** (cómo se agregan las partículas) es lo que el manejo construye o aplasta, y el perfil estratificado desde el horizonte A hasta la roca madre muestra por dónde viajan el agua y los nutrientes.

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. El **pH** rige si los nutrientes están químicamente disponibles, y la **CIC** rige cuántos de ellos puede retener el suelo; por eso la materia orgánica, que eleva la CIC y mejora la estructura a la vez, es el elemento más valioso en un campo.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Autoevaluación

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **P1.** ¿Qué propiedad del suelo es esencialmente permanente y no puede cambiarse de manera práctica mediante el manejo agrícola?

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) Estructura del suelo

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) Textura del suelo

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) pH del suelo

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) Capacidad de intercambio catiónico

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **P2.** El cultivo de un agricultor muestra un amarillamiento entre las venas de las hojas (síntomas de deficiencia de hierro), pero una prueba de suelo muestra que hay abundante hierro presente.

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: ¿Cuál es la causa más probable?

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) El pH del suelo es demasiado alto (alcalino), lo que hace que el hierro no esté disponible

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) El suelo tiene demasiada materia orgánica

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) El horizonte A es demasiado profundo

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) La textura del suelo es demasiado arenosa

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **P3.** V/F: En una capa superficial del suelo saludable, aproximadamente la mitad del volumen es espacio poroso lleno de agua y aire.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Glosario de hoy

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **Textura del suelo** — La proporción relativa de partículas de arena, limo y arcilla en un suelo; una propiedad fija utilizada para asignar una clase de textura como franco o arcilla limosa.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **Estructura del suelo** — Cómo se unen las partículas individuales en agregados (peds), lo que determina el tamaño de los poros, el drenaje y la aireación; a diferencia de la textura, se puede construir o destruir mediante el manejo.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte del suelo** — Una capa distinta en el perfil del suelo (O, A, E, B, C, R) formada por la meteorización y el movimiento descendente de agua y materiales.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **pH del suelo** — Una medida de la acidez o alcalinidad del suelo que controla la disponibilidad química de los nutrientes; la mayoría de los cultivos se desarrollan mejor entre aproximadamente 6.0 y 7.0.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **Capacidad de intercambio catiónico (CIC)** — La capacidad del suelo para retener nutrientes intercambiables cargados positivamente en las superficies negativas de la arcilla y el humus; una CIC más alta significa una mejor retención de nutrientes.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *Respuesta: **Q1 — B.** La textura está determinada por el tamaño de las partículas minerales heredadas del material parental; cambiarla requeriría reemplazar físicamente volúmenes enormes de suelo.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: La estructura, el pH y la CIC pueden modificarse mediante la labranza, la cal y la materia orgánica.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** Por encima de un pH de aproximadamente 7.5, el hierro se convierte en formas que las plantas no pueden absorber, por lo que la deficiencia es de disponibilidad, no de cantidad; esto se llama clorosis inducida por cal.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — V.** Alrededor del 25% de agua más el 25% de aire significa que aproximadamente la mitad del volumen es espacio poroso; la división exacta cambia constantemente a medida que el suelo se moja y se drena, pero el espacio poroso total se mantiene casi igual a menos que el suelo se compacte.*

ar.title: [الزراعة 101 #3] التراب ليس تربة: الآلة ذات الطبقات الأربع تحت قدميك

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > التربة هي بنية حية ذات طبقات تتكون من جزيئات معدنية، ومواد عضوية، وماء، وهواء — ويحدد قوامها وبنيتها وخصائصها الكيميائية ما إذا كانت البذرة ستتحول إلى حصاد وفير أم إلى فشل.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## مفهوم اليوم

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: خذ حفنة من التربة من فناء خلفي في آيوا أو من حوض زراعي مرتفع في بروكلين.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: قد تبدو مجرد مادة بنية اللون.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: لكنها في الواقع نظام يتكون من أربعة أجزاء، وتتكون التربة السطحية الصحية تقريبًا من:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% جزيئات معدنية** — صخور مطحونة

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% مواد عضوية** — نباتات ميتة، وجذور، وميكروبات، والدبال الذي تتحول إليه

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: هذا الرقم الأخير يثير دهشة الناس.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: ربع التربة الجيدة عبارة عن *مساحة فارغة مليئة بالهواء*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: الجذور تتنفس.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: إذا طردت الماء ذلك الهواء، فإن النبات يختنق، وهو بالضبط ما يحدث في الحقول الغدقة بالمياه.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **القوام: وصفة الجزيئات الثلاثة.** يصنف علماء التربة الجزيئات المعدنية حسب الحجم إلى ثلاث فئات:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: نسبة هذه العناصر الثلاثة هي **قوام التربة**، وهي ثابتة بشكل أساسي — لا يمكنك نقل ما يكفي من الرمل لتغيير حقل طيني.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: يُقرأ القوام من مثلث قوام التربة التابع لوزارة الزراعة الأمريكية (USDA)، والذي يحدد 12 فئة.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: الأكثر شهرة في مجال الزراعة هي **التربة الطفالية** (حوالي 40% رمل، 40% غرين، 20% طين): رمل كافٍ للتصريف، وطين كافٍ للاحتفاظ بالماء والمغذيات.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: لماذا يهم حجم الجزيئات إلى هذا الحد؟

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **مساحة السطح.** غرام واحد من الرمل يحتوي على بضع مئات من السنتيمترات المربعة من السطح.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: بينما غرام واحد من الطين يحتوي على مئات *الأمتار المربعة*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: تلتصق المغذيات بأسطح الجزيئات، لذا يحتفظ الطين بالمغذيات والماء؛ بينما يسمح الرمل بمرور كليهما مباشرة من خلاله.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **البنية: كيف تتكتل الجزيئات.** القوام هو المكونات؛ أما **البنية** فهي كيفية تجميعها معًا.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: ترتبط الجزيئات في كتل وحبيبات تسمى **التجمعات** أو **الكتل الهيكلية**، وتلتصق ببعضها البعض بواسطة المواد العضوية، والخيوط الفطرية، والإفرازات الميكروبية.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: البنية الجيدة — الهشة الشبيهة بجبن القريش — تخلق حجمين من المسام في آن واحد: مسام كبيرة تصرف المياه وتسمح بدخول الهواء، ومسام صغيرة تحتفظ بالماء للجذور.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: البنية هشة.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: إن قيادة جرار ثقيل فوق أرض رطبة يسحقها ويؤدي إلى **انضغاط التربة**، والتربة المنضغطة تقاوم نمو الجذور وتغلغل مياه الأمطار.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
