segments.tr: **قطاع التربة: قراءة الطبقات.** احفر حفرة وسترى **الآفاق**، وهي مصنفة من الأعلى إلى الأسفل:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **الأفق O** — الحطام السطحي، والأوراق، والبقايا (رقيق أو غائب في الأراضي الزراعية المحروثة)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **الأفق A** — التربة السطحية. داكنة، غنية بالمواد العضوية، حيث تعيش معظم الجذور والكائنات الحية. غالبًا ما يتراوح عمقها بين 15 و25 سم فقط.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **الأفق E** — طبقة شاحبة مغسولة، حيث جُرفت الطين والمعادن إلى الأسفل (غير موجودة في جميع أنواع التربة)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **الأفق B** — التربة تحت السطحية. منطقة التراكم، حيث تتجمع المعادن والطين المغسول من الأعلى. أكثر كثافة وأفتح لونًا.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **الأفق C** — المادة الأم المجواة، وهي شظايا صخرية بالكاد تغيرت

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **الأفق R** — الصخر الأساسي

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: هذا الأفق العلوي A هو أساس اللعبة بأكملها.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: يستغرق بناء بضعة سنتيمترات منه قرونًا، وتكفي عاصفة واحدة سيئة على أرض جرداء لجرْفه إلى النهر.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **الكيمياء: الرقم الهيدروجيني وتبادل المغذيات.** تهيمن خاصيتان كيميائيتان.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: يتراوح **الرقم الهيدروجيني للتربة (pH)** بين 0 و14، وتفضل معظم المحاصيل نطاقًا يتراوح بين 6.0 و7.0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: السبب ليس أن النباتات تكره الحموضة — بل لأن الرقم الهيدروجيني يتحكم في *إتاحة* المغذيات.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: في التربة الحمضية التي يقل رقمها الهيدروجيني عن 5.5 تقريبًا، يرتبط الفوسفور بالحديد والألومنيوم، ويصبح الألومنيوم نفسه قابلاً للذوبان بدرجة كافية لتسميم الجذور.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: أما فوق 7.5، يصبح الحديد والزنك والمنغنيز غير متاحين، ولهذا السبب تصفر النباتات في التربة القلوية بين عروق الأوراق على الرغم من وجود الحديد ماديًا هناك.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: يرفع المزارعون الرقم الهيدروجيني باستخدام الحجر الجيري الزراعي ويخفضونه باستخدام الكبريت العنصري.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **السعة التبادلية الكاتيونية (CEC)** هي بطارية تخزين المغذيات في التربة.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: تحمل جزيئات الطين والدبال شحنات سطحية سالبة، لذا فهي تحتفظ بالمغذيات ذات الشحنة الموجبة — الكالسيوم والمغنيسيوم والبوتاسيوم والأمونيوم — وتطلقها للجذور عند الطلب.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: تُقاس السعة التبادلية الكاتيونية بالسنتيمول من الشحنة لكل كيلوغرام.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: قد تكون في التربة الرملية عند قيمة 3؛ بينما تصل في التربة الطينية والدبالية إلى 25 أو أكثر.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: تعني السعة التبادلية الكاتيونية العالية بقاء الأسمدة في مكانها.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: أما السعة المنخفضة فتعني غسلها مع المطر التالي، ولهذا السبب يتم تسميد الحقول الرملية بجرعات صغيرة ومتكررة بدلاً من جرعة واحدة كبيرة.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: فكر في الفرق بين حديقة في ساحل نيوجيرسي وأخرى في وسط أوهايو.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: تقع حديقة ساحل نيوجيرسي على تربة رملية.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: تختفي المياه بعد دقائق من هطول الأمطار الغزيرة، لذا يتحول العشب إلى اللون البني في غضون أسبوع من الطقس الجاف.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: السعة التبادلية الكاتيونية منخفضة، لذا ينشر صاحب المنزل كيس سماد بقيمة 40 دولارًا، ويحصل على أسبوعين من اللون الأخضر الداكن، ثم يراه يتلاشى — حيث غُسل معظم النيتروجين تحت منطقة الجذور.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: الحل ليس في زيادة السماد بل في *زيادة المواد العضوية*: فالسماد العضوي (الكومبوست) يرفع القدرة على الاحتفاظ بالماء والسعة التبادلية الكاتيونية معًا، لأن الدبال هو أحد أعلى المواد سعة تبادلية كاتيونية في التربة.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: أما حديقة أوهايو فتقع على تربة طينية طفالية ثقيلة.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: وهنا تظهر مشاكل معاكسة.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: بعد المطر، تظل البرك قائمة ليوم كامل لأن المسام صغيرة والتصريف بطيء.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: المشي عليها وهي مشبعة بالماء يؤدي إلى انضغاطها، مما يدمر البنية ويخلق طبقة صلبة لا تستطيع الجذور اختراقها.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: وبحلول شهر أغسطس، تتشقق مثل قاع بحيرة جافة.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: الحل هنا هو أيضًا إضافة المواد العضوية — ولكن لسبب معاكس.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: يربط الدبال جزيئات الطين في تجمعات، مما يفتح المسام الكبيرة التي تفتقر إليها التربة الطينية.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: نفس المادة المضافة، بآليتين مختلفتين.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: هذه هي الفائدة العملية لفهم الفرق بين القوام والبنية: القوام ترثه وتتعامل معه كما هو، أما البنية فيمكنك بناؤها أو تدميرها بالفعل.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: هناك نتيجة يومية أخرى.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: عندما تعود نتيجة تحليل التربة من مكتب الإرشاد الزراعي في مقاطعتك، فإنها توضح ثلاثة أشياء تعرفها الآن: فئة القوام، والرقم الهيدروجيني، والسعة التبادلية الكاتيونية (غالبًا إلى جانب نسبة المواد العضوية).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: يكلف التحليل النموذجي حوالي 15-30 دولارًا في الولايات المتحدة.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: وتعتمد ورقة التوصيات — كمية الجير المطلوبة، وكمية كل عنصر مغذٍ — بالكامل تقريبًا على تلك الأرقام.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: تحليل التربة ليس مجرد إجراء شكلي؛ بل هو الحد الفاصل بين تغذية المحصول وتغذية المجرى المائي بأكمله.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## ملخص من 3 نقاط

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. تتكون التربة من حوالي 45% معادن، و5% مواد عضوية، و25% ماء، و25% هواء — والهواء ليس اختياريًا، لأن الجذور تتنفس.

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. يحدد **القوام** (نسبة الرمل والغرين والطين الثابتة) الحد الأقصى لقدرات التربة؛ بينما **البنية** (كيفية تكتل الجزيئات) هي ما تبنيه الإدارة الزراعية أو تدمره، ويوضح القطاع الطبقي من الأفق A وصولاً إلى الصخر الأساسي مسار حركة الماء والمغذيات.

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. يتحكم **الرقم الهيدروجيني** في مدى إتاحة المغذيات كيميائيًا، وتتحكم **السعة التبادلية الكاتيونية** في كمية المغذيات التي يمكن للتربة الاحتفاظ بها — ولهذا السبب تعد المادة العضوية، التي ترفع السعة التبادلية الكاتيونية وتحسن البنية في آن واحد، أثمن شيء في الحقل.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ اختبار ذاتي

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **س1.** أي من خصائص التربة تعتبر ثابتة بشكل أساسي ولا يمكن تغييرها عمليًا من خلال الإدارة الزراعية؟

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - أ) بنية التربة

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - ب) قوام التربة

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - ج) الرقم الهيدروجيني للتربة

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - د) السعة التبادلية الكاتيونية

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **س2.** تظهر على محاصيل أحد المزارعين علامات اصفرار بين عروق الأوراق (أعراض نقص الحديد)، لكن تحليل التربة يظهر وجود كميات وفيرة من الحديد.

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: ما هو السبب الأكثر احتمالاً؟

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - أ) الرقم الهيدروجيني للتربة مرتفع جدًا (قلوي)، مما يجعل الحديد غير متاح للنبات

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - ب) تحتوي التربة على الكثير من المواد العضوية

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - ج) الأفق A عميق جدًا

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - د) قوام التربة رملي للغاية

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **س3.** صح أم خطأ: في التربة السطحية الصحية، يكون حوالي نصف الحجم عبارة عن مسام مليئة بالماء والهواء.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 مصطلحات اليوم

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **قوام التربة** — النسبة النسبية لجزيئات الرمل والغرين والطين في التربة؛ وهي خاصية ثابتة تُستخدم لتحديد فئة القوام مثل التربة الطفالية أو الطينية الغرينية.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **بنية التربة** — كيفية ارتباط الجزيئات الفردية في تجمعات (كتل هيكلية)، مما يحدد أحجام المسام، والتصريف، والتهوية؛ وعلى عكس القوام، يمكن بناؤها أو تدميرها من خلال الإدارة الزراعية.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **أفق التربة** — طبقة مميزة في قطاع التربة (O, A, E, B, C, R) تتشكل بفعل التجوية وحركة المياه والمواد إلى الأسفل.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **الرقم الهيدروجيني للتربة** — مقياس لحموضة التربة أو قلويتها يتحكم في الإتاحة الكيميائية للمغذيات؛ وتؤدي معظم المحاصيل أفضل أداء لها بين 6.0 و7.0 تقريبًا.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **السعة التبادلية الكاتيونية (CEC)** — قدرة التربة على الاحتفاظ بالمغذيات ذات الشحنة الموجبة القابلة للتبادل على الأسطح السالبة للطين والدبال؛ وتعني السعة الأعلى احتفاظًا أفضل بالمغذيات.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *الإجابة: **س1 — ب.** يتحدد القوام بأحجام الجزيئات المعدنية الموروثة من المادة الأم؛ وتغييره يتطلب استبدال كميات هائلة من التربة ماديًا.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: بينما يمكن تغيير البنية، والرقم الهيدروجيني، والسعة التبادلية الكاتيونية عن طريق الحراثة، وإضافة الجير، والمواد العضو.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **س2 — أ.** فوق الرقم الهيدروجيني 7.5 تقريبًا، يتحول الحديد إلى أشكال لا تستطيع النباتات امتصاصها، لذا فإن النقص يتعلق بالإتاحة وليس بالكمية — ويسمى هذا بالكلوروز الناجم عن الجير.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **س3 — صح.** حوالي 25% ماء بالإضافة إلى 25% هواء يعني أن نصف الحجم تقريبًا عبارة عن مسام؛ وتتغير النسبة الدقيقة باستمرار مع ترطيب التربة وتصريفها، لكن إجمالي مساحة المسام يظل ثابتًا تقريبًا ما لم يتم دمج التربة وانضغاطها.*

fr.title: [Agriculture 101 #3] La terre n'est pas le sol : la machine à quatre couches sous vos pieds

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > Le sol est une structure vivante et stratifiée composée de particules minérales, de matière organique, d'eau et d'air — et sa texture, sa structure et sa chimie déterminent si une graine devient une récolte ou un échec.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Concepts du jour

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: Prenez une poignée de terre dans un jardin de l'Iowa ou dans un bac de culture à Brooklyn.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: Cela ressemble à de la matière brune.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: Il s'agit en réalité d'un système en quatre parties, et une terre végétale saine est composée approximativement de :

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45 % de particules minérales** — de la roche broyée

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5 % de matière organique** — plantes mortes, racines, microbes et l'humus qu'ils deviennent

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: Ce dernier chiffre surprend les gens.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: Un quart d'un bon sol est constitué d'*espace vide rempli d'air*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: Les racines respirent.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: Si vous chassez cet air, la plante s'étouffe, ce qui est exactement ce qui se produit dans un champ gorgé d'eau.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **Texture : la recette à trois particules.** Les pédologues classent les particules minérales par taille en trois catégories :

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: La proportion de ces trois éléments constitue la **texture du sol**, et elle est essentiellement permanente — vous ne pouvez pas apporter assez de sable par camion pour modifier un champ argileux.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: La texture se lit sur le triangle textural du sol de l'USDA, qui définit 12 classes.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: La plus célèbre en agriculture est le **limon** (environ 40 % de sable, 40 % de limon, 20 % d'argile) : assez de sable pour drainer, assez d'argile pour retenir l'eau et les nutriments.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: Pourquoi la taille des particules est-elle si importante ?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **Surface spécifique.** Un gramme de sable a quelques centaines de centimètres carrés de surface.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: Un gramme d'argile a des centaines de *mètres carrés*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: Les nutriments s'accrochent aux surfaces des particules, donc l'argile retient les nutriments et l'eau ; le sable laisse tout passer directement.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **Structure : comment les particules s'agglutinent.** La texture est constituée des ingrédients ; la **structure** est la façon dont ils sont assemblés.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: Les particules se lient en miettes et en blocs appelés **agrégats** ou **peds**, collés ensemble par la matière organique, les filaments fongiques et les sécrétions microbiennes.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: Une bonne structure — friable, semblable à du fromage cottage — crée deux tailles de pores à la fois : de gros pores qui drainent et laissent passer l'air, et de petits pores qui retiennent l'eau pour les racines.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: La structure est fragile.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: Passer un tracteur lourd sur un sol humide l'écrase, provoquant un **tassement**, et un sol compacté résiste à la fois aux racines et à la pluie.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **Le profil du sol : lire les couches.** Creusez une fosse et vous verrez des **horizons**, étiquetés depuis le haut :

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **Horizon O** — litière de surface, feuilles et résidus (mince ou absent dans les terres cultivées)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **Horizon A** — terre végétale. Sombre, riche en matière organique, là où vivent la plupart des racines et la biologie. Souvent seulement 15–25 cm de profondeur.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **Horizon E** — une couche lessivée et pâle où l'argile et les minéraux ont été entraînés vers le bas (pas présent dans tous les sols)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **Horizon B** — sous-sol. La zone d'accumulation, où l'argile et les minéraux lessivés depuis le haut se collectent. Plus dense, de couleur plus claire.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **Horizon C** — matériau parental altéré, fragments de roche à peine modifiés

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **Horizon R** — roche mère

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: Cet horizon A supérieur est tout ce qui compte.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: Il faut des siècles pour en construire quelques centimètres et une seule mauvaise tempête sur un sol nu pour l'emporter dans une rivière.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **Chimie : le pH et la poignée de main des nutriments.** Deux propriétés chimiques dominent.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: Le **pH du sol** varie de 0 à 14, et la plupart des cultures préfèrent une valeur entre 6,0 et 7,0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: La raison n'est pas que les plantes n'aiment pas l'acidité — c'est que le pH contrôle la *disponibilité* des nutriments.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: Dans un sol acide en dessous d'environ 5,5, le phosphore se bloque avec le fer et l'aluminium, et l'aluminium lui-même devient suffisamment soluble pour empoisonner les racines.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: Au-dessus de 7,5, le fer, le zinc et le manganèse deviennent indisponibles, c'est pourquoi les plantes dans un sol alcalin jaunissent entre les nervures même si le fer est physiquement présent.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: Les agriculteurs augmentent le pH avec de la chaux agricole et le diminuent avec du soufre élémentaire.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: La **capacité d'échange cationique (CEC)** est la batterie de stockage des nutriments du sol.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: Les particules d'argile et l'humus portent des charges de surface négatives, ils retiennent donc les nutriments chargés positivement — calcium, magnésium, potassium, ammonium — et les libèrent aux racines à la demande.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: La CEC est mesurée en centimoles de charge par kilogramme.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: Un sol sableux pourrait être à 3 ; un sol argilo-humique à 25 ou plus.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: Une CEC élevée signifie que l'engrais reste en place.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: Une CEC faible signifie qu'il est lessivé à la prochaine pluie, c'est pourquoi les champs sableux sont fertilisés en petites doses fréquentes plutôt qu'en une seule grosse application.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Pensez à la différence entre une pelouse sur la côte du New Jersey et une dans le centre de l'Ohio.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: La pelouse du bord de mer du New Jersey repose sur un sol sableux.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: L'eau disparaît quelques minutes après une averse, donc l'herbe brunit en une semaine de temps sec.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: La CEC est faible, donc le propriétaire épand un sac d'engrais pour pelouse à 40 $, obtient deux semaines d'un vert profond, et regarde la couleur s'estomper — la majeure partie de l'azote ayant été lavée sous la zone racinaire.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: La solution n'est pas plus d'engrais mais *plus de matière organique* : le compost augmente à la fois la capacité de rétention d'eau et la CEC, car l'humus est l'un des matériaux à la CEC la plus élevée dans le sol.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: La pelouse de l'Ohio repose sur un limon argileux lourd.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: Problèmes opposés.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: Après la pluie, les flaques stagnent pendant une journée car les pores sont petits et le drainage est lent.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: Marchez dessus pendant qu'il est trempé et vous le tassez, détruisant la structure et créant une semelle de labour que les racines ne traverseront pas.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: En août, il se fissure comme un lit de lac asséché.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: La solution ici est aussi la matière organique — mais pour la raison opposée.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: L'humus lie les particules d'argile en agrégats, ce qui ouvre les grands pores qui manquent au sol argileux.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: Même amendement, deux mécanismes différents.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: C'est l'avantage pratique de comprendre la texture par rapport à la structure : la texture est héritée et on doit faire avec, la structure peut être réellement construite ou détruite.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: Une conséquence quotidienne supplémentaire.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: Lorsqu'un test de sol de votre bureau de vulgarisation agricole revient, il rapporte trois choses que vous reconnaissez maintenant : la classe de texture, le pH et la CEC (souvent avec le pourcentage de matière organique).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: Un test typique coûte environ 15–30 $ aux États-Unis.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: La fiche de recommandation — combien de chaux, combien de chaque nutriment — est générée presque entièrement à partir de ces chiffres.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: Un test de sol n'est pas une formalité ; c'est la différence entre nourrir la culture et nourrir le bassin versant.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Résumé en 3 points

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. Le sol est composé d'environ 45 % de minéraux, 5 % de matière organique, 25 % d'eau et 25 % d'air — et l'air n'est pas optionnel, car les racines respirent.

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. La **texture** (le rapport fixe sable-limon-argile) définit le plafond d'un sol ; la **structure** (comment les particules s'agrègent) est ce que la gestion améliore ou détruit, et le profil stratifié de l'horizon A jusqu'à la roche mère montre où voyagent l'eau et les nutriments.

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. Le **pH** régit la disponibilité chimique des nutriments, et la **CEC** régit la quantité que le sol peut en retenir — c'est pourquoi la matière organique, qui augmente la CEC et améliore la structure à la fois, est l'élément le plus précieux dans un champ.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Auto-quiz

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **Q1.** Quelle propriété du sol est essentiellement permanente et ne peut pas être pratiquement modifiée par la gestion agricole ?

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) Structure du sol

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) Texture du sol

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) pH du sol

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) Capacité d'échange cationique

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **Q2.** La culture d'un agriculteur montre un jaunissement entre les nervures des feuilles (symptômes de carence en fer), mais un test de sol montre qu'il y a beaucoup de fer présent.

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: Quelle est la cause la plus probable ?

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) Le pH du sol est trop élevé (alcalin), rendant le fer indisponible

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) Le sol a trop de matière organique

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) L'horizon A est trop profond

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) La texture du sol est trop sableuse

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **Q3.** Vrai/Faux : Dans une terre végétale saine, environ la moitié du volume est constitué d'espace poreux rempli d'eau et d'air.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termes du jour

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **Texture du sol** — La proportion relative de particules de sable, de limon et d'argile dans un sol ; une propriété fixe utilisée pour attribuer une classe texturale telle que limon ou argile limoneuse.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **Structure du sol** — La façon dont les particules individuelles se lient en agrégats (peds), ce qui détermine la taille des pores, le drainage et l'aération ; contrairement à la texture, elle peut être construite ou détruite par la gestion.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **Horizon du sol** — Une couche distincte dans le profil du sol (O, A, E, B, C, R) formée par l'altération et le mouvement descendant de l'eau et des matériaux.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **pH du sol** — Une mesure de l'acidité ou de l'alcalinité du sol qui contrôle la disponibilité chimique des nutriments ; la plupart des cultures fonctionnent mieux entre environ 6,0 et 7,0.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **Capacité d'échange cationique (CEC)** — La capacité du sol à retenir des nutriments échangeables chargés positivement sur les surfaces négatives de l'argile et de l'humus ; une CEC plus élevée signifie une meilleure rétention des nutriments.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *Réponse : **Q1 — B.** La texture est déterminée par la taille des particules minérales héritées du matériau parental ; la changer nécessiterait de remplacer physiquement d'énormes volumes de sol.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: La structure, le pH et la CEC peuvent tous être modifiés par le travail du sol, la chaux et la matière organique.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** Au-dessus d'un pH d'environ 7,5, le fer se convertit en formes que les plantes ne peuvent pas absorber, donc la carence est une question de disponibilité, pas de quantité — c'est ce qu'on appelle la chlorose induite par le calcaire.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — Vrai.** Environ 25 % d'eau plus 25 % d'air signifie qu'environ la moitié du volume est de l'espace poreux ; la répartition exacte change constamment à mesure que le sol s'humidifie et se draine, mais l'espace poreux total reste à peu près le même à moins que le sol ne soit compacté.*

pt.title: [Agricultura 101 #3] Terra não é Solo: A Máquina de Quatro Camadas Sob Seus Pés

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > O solo é uma estrutura viva e estratificada feita de partículas minerais, matéria orgânica, água e ar — e sua textura, estrutura e química decidem se uma semente se torna uma colheita ou um fracasso.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Conceitos de hoje

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: Pegue um punhado de solo de um quintal em Iowa ou de um canteiro elevado no Brooklyn.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: Parece apenas uma coisa marrom.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: Na verdade, é um sistema de quatro partes, e um solo superficial saudável é composto aproximadamente por:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% partículas minerais** — rocha moída

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% matéria orgânica** — plantas mortas, raízes, micróbios e o húmus em que se transformam

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: Esse último número surpreende as pessoas.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: Um quarto de um bom solo é *espaço vazio preenchido com ar*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: As raízes respiram.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: Afogue esse ar e a planta sufoca, que é exatamente o que acontece em um campo encharcado.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **Textura: a receita de três partículas.** Os cientistas do solo classificam as partículas minerais por tamanho em três classes:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: A proporção dessas três é a **textura do solo**, e ela é essencialmente permanente — você não pode trazer areia suficiente em caminhões para mudar um campo de argila.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: A textura é lida no triângulo textural do solo do USDA, que nomeia 12 classes.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: A mais famosa na agricultura é o **franco** (aproximadamente 40% areia, 40% silte, 20% argila): areia suficiente para drenar, argila suficiente para reter água e nutrientes.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: Por que o tamanho da partícula importa tanto?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **Área de superfície.** Um grama de areia tem algumas centenas de centímetros quadrados de superfície.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: Um grama de argila tem centenas de *metros quadrados*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: Os nutrientes aderem às superfícies das partículas, então a argila retém nutrientes e água; a areia deixa ambos passarem direto.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **Estrutura: como as partículas se aglomeram.** A textura são os ingredientes; a **estrutura** é como eles são montados.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: As partículas se unem em migalhas e blocos chamados **agregados** ou **peds**, colados por matéria orgânica, filamentos fúngicos e secreções microbianas.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: Uma boa estrutura — esfarelável, semelhante a queijo cottage — cria dois tamanhos de poros ao mesmo tempo: poros grandes que drenam e admitem ar, poros pequenos que retêm água para as raízes.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: A estrutura é frágil.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: Dirigir um trator pesado sobre solo úmido o esmaga, causando **compactação**, e o solo compactado resiste tanto às raízes quanto à chuva.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **O perfil do solo: lendo as camadas.** Cave um buraco e você verá **horizontes**, rotulados a partir do topo:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **Horizonte O** — serapilheira, folhas e resíduos (fino ou ausente em terras cultivadas)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte A** — solo superficial. Escuro, rico em matéria orgânica, onde vive a maior parte das raízes e da biologia. Frequentemente com apenas 15–25 cm de profundidade.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **Horizonte E** — uma camada lixiviada e pálida onde argila e minerais foram lavados para baixo (não presente em todos os solos)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte B** — subsolo. A zona de acumulação, onde a argila e os minerais lavados de cima se coletam. Mais denso, de cor mais clara.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **Horizonte C** — material de origem intemperizado, fragmentos de rocha pouco alterados

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **Horizonte R** — rocha matriz

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: Esse horizonte A superior é o que realmente importa.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: Leva séculos para construir alguns centímetros dele e uma tempestade ruim em solo nu para movê-lo para um rio.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **Química: pH e o aperto de mão dos nutrientes.** Duas propriedades químicas dominam.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **O pH do solo** varia de 0–14, e a maioria das culturas prefere 6.0–7.0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: A razão não é que as plantas não gostam de ácido — é que o pH controla a *disponibilidade* de nutrientes.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: Em solo ácido abaixo de cerca de 5.5, o fósforo se prende ao ferro e ao alumínio, e o próprio alumínio torna-se solúvel o suficiente para envenenar as raízes.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: Acima de 7.5, ferro, zinco e manganês tornam-se indisponíveis, e é por isso que as plantas em solo alcalino ficam amarelas entre as nervuras, mesmo que o ferro esteja fisicamente lá.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: Os agricultores elevam o pH com calcário agrícola e o reduzem com enxofre elementar.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **Capacidade de troca catiônica (CTC)** é a bateria de armazenamento de nutrientes do solo.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: Partículas de argila e húmus carregam cargas superficiais negativas, então eles retêm nutrientes carregados positivamente — cálcio, magnésio, potássio, amônio — e os liberam para as raízes conforme a demanda.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: A CTC é medida em centimoles de carga por quilograma.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: Um solo arenoso pode ficar em 3; um solo de argila e húmus em 25 ou mais.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: Uma CTC alta significa que o fertilizante permanece no lugar.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: Uma CTC baixa significa que ele é lixiviado com a próxima chuva, e é por isso que campos arenosos são fertilizados em doses pequenas e frequentes em vez de uma grande aplicação.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## No dia a dia

segments.src: Think about the difference between a lawn in coastal New Jersey and one in central Ohio.
segments.tr: Pense na diferença entre um gramado na costa de Nova Jersey e um no centro de Ohio.

segments.src: The Jersey shore lawn sits on sandy soil.
segments.tr: O gramado da costa de Jersey fica em solo arenoso.

segments.src: Water vanishes minutes after a downpour, so the grass browns within a week of dry weather.
segments.tr: A água desaparece minutos após uma chuva forte, então a grama fica marrom dentro de uma semana de tempo seco.

segments.src: CEC is low, so the homeowner spreads a $40 bag of lawn fertilizer, gets two weeks of deep green, and watches it fade — most of the nitrogen washed below the root zone.
segments.tr: A CTC é baixa, então o proprietário espalha um saco de $40 de fertilizante para gramado, obtém duas semanas de verde profundo e vê isso desaparecer — a maior parte do nitrogênio é lavada abaixo da zona radicular.

segments.src: The fix is not more fertilizer but *more organic matter*: compost raises both water-holding capacity and CEC, because humus is one of the highest-CEC materials in soil.
segments.tr: A solução não é mais fertilizante, mas *mais matéria orgânica*: o composto aumenta tanto a capacidade de retenção de água quanto a CTC, porque o húmus é um dos materiais com maior CTC no solo.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: O gramado de Ohio fica em um franco-argiloso pesado.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: Problemas opostos.

segments.src: After rain, puddles sit for a day because the pores are small and drainage is slow.
segments.tr: Após a chuva, poças permanecem por um dia porque os poros são pequenos e a drenagem é lenta.

segments.src: Walk on it while it's soaked and you compact it, destroying structure and creating a hardpan that roots won't cross.
segments.tr: Andar sobre ele enquanto está encharcado o compacta, destruindo a estrutura e criando uma camada dura que as raízes não atravessarão.

segments.src: Come August it cracks like a dry lakebed.
segments.tr: Chegando em agosto, ele racha como o leito de um lago seco.

segments.src: The fix here is also organic matter — but for the opposite reason.
segments.tr: A solução aqui também é matéria orgânica — mas pelo motivo oposto.

segments.src: Humus binds clay particles into aggregates, which opens up the large pores that clay soil lacks.
segments.tr: O húmus une as partículas de argila em agregados, o que abre os poros grandes que faltam no solo argiloso.

segments.src: Same amendment, two different mechanisms.
segments.tr: Mesmo corretivo, dois mecanismos diferentes.

segments.src: That is the practical payoff of understanding texture versus structure: texture you inherit and manage around, structure you can actually build or destroy.
segments.tr: Esse é o benefício prático de entender textura versus estrutura: a textura você herda e gerencia, a estrutura você pode realmente construir ou destruir.

segments.src: One more everyday consequence.
segments.tr: Mais uma consequência do dia a dia.

segments.src: When a soil test from your county extension office comes back, it reports three things you now recognize: texture class, pH, and CEC (often alongside organic matter percentage).
segments.tr: Quando um teste de solo do seu escritório de extensão rural retorna, ele relata três coisas que você agora reconhece: classe de textura, pH e CTC (frequentemente junto com a porcentagem de matéria orgânica).

segments.src: A typical test costs roughly $15–30 in the US.
segments.tr: Um teste típico custa cerca de $15–30 nos EUA.

segments.src: The recommendation sheet — how much lime, how much of each nutrient — is generated almost entirely from those numbers.
segments.tr: A folha de recomendação — quanto calcário, quanto de cada nutriente — é gerada quase inteiramente a partir desses números.

segments.src: A soil test is not a formality; it is the difference between feeding the crop and feeding the watershed.
segments.tr: Um teste de solo não é uma formalidade; é a diferença entre alimentar a cultura e alimentar a bacia hidrográfica.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Resumo em 3 pontos

segments.src: 1. Soil is about 45% mineral, 5% organic matter, 25% water, and 25% air — and the air is not optional, because roots respire.
segments.tr: 1. O solo é cerca de 45% mineral, 5% matéria orgânica, 25% água e 25% ar — e o ar não é opcional, porque as raízes respiram.

segments.src: 2. **Texture** (the fixed sand-silt-clay ratio) sets a soil's ceiling; **structure** (how particles aggregate) is what management builds up or crushes, and the layered profile from A horizon down to bedrock shows where water and nutrients travel.
segments.tr: 2. **Textura** (a proporção fixa de areia-silte-argila) define o limite do solo; **estrutura** (como as partículas se agregam) é o que o manejo constrói ou destrói, e o perfil estratificado do horizonte A até a rocha matriz mostra por onde a água e os nutrientes viajam.

segments.src: 3. **pH** governs whether nutrients are chemically available, and **CEC** governs how many of them the soil can hold — which is why organic matter, which raises CEC and improves structure at once, is the single most valuable thing in a field.
segments.tr: 3. **pH** governa se os nutrientes estão quimicamente disponíveis, e a **CTC** governa quantos deles o solo pode reter — e é por isso que a matéria orgânica, que aumenta a CTC e melhora a estrutura ao mesmo tempo, é a coisa mais valiosa em um campo.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Auto-quiz

segments.src: **Q1.** Which soil property is essentially permanent and cannot be practically changed by farm management?
segments.tr: **Q1.** Qual propriedade do solo é essencialmente permanente e não pode ser praticamente alterada pelo manejo agrícola?

segments.src: - A) Soil structure
segments.tr: - A) Estrutura do solo

segments.src: - B) Soil texture
segments.tr: - B) Textura do solo

segments.src: - C) Soil pH
segments.tr: - C) pH do solo

segments.src: - D) Cation exchange capacity
segments.tr: - D) Capacidade de troca catiônica

segments.src: **Q2.** A farmer's crop shows yellowing between leaf veins (iron deficiency symptoms), but a soil test shows plenty of iron present.
segments.tr: **Q2.** A cultura de um agricultor mostra amarelamento entre as nervuras das folhas (sintomas de deficiência de ferro), mas um teste de solo mostra muito ferro presente.

segments.src: What is the most likely cause?
segments.tr: Qual é a causa mais provável?

segments.src: - A) The soil pH is too high (alkaline), making iron unavailable
segments.tr: - A) O pH do solo está muito alto (alcalino), tornando o ferro indisponível

segments.src: - B) The soil has too much organic matter
segments.tr: - B) O solo tem muita matéria orgânica

segments.src: - C) The A horizon is too deep
segments.tr: - C) O horizonte A é muito profundo

segments.src: - D) The soil texture is too sandy
segments.tr: - D) A textura do solo é muito arenosa

segments.src: **Q3.** O/X: In a healthy topsoil, roughly half the volume is pore space filled with water and air.
segments.tr: **Q3.** V/F: Em um solo superficial saudável, aproximadamente metade do volume é espaço poroso preenchido com água e ar.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termos de hoje

segments.src: - **Soil texture** — The relative proportion of sand, silt, and clay particles in a soil; a fixed property used to assign a textural class such as loam or silty clay.
segments.tr: - **Textura do solo** — A proporção relativa de partículas de areia, silte e argila em um solo; uma propriedade fixa usada para atribuir uma classe textural, como franco ou argila siltosa.

segments.src: - **Soil structure** — How individual particles bind into aggregates (peds), which determines pore sizes, drainage, and aeration; unlike texture, it can be built or destroyed by management.
segments.tr: - **Estrutura do solo** — Como as partículas individuais se unem em agregados (peds), o que determina o tamanho dos poros, a drenagem e a aeração; ao contrário da textura, pode ser construída ou destruída pelo manejo.

segments.src: - **Soil horizon** — A distinct layer in the soil profile (O, A, E, B, C, R) formed by weathering and the downward movement of water and materials.
segments.tr: - **Horizonte do solo** — Uma camada distinta no perfil do solo (O, A, E, B, C, R) formada pelo intemperismo e pelo movimento descendente de água e materiais.

segments.src: - **Soil pH** — A measure of soil acidity or alkalinity that controls the chemical availability of nutrients; most crops perform best between about 6.0 and 7.0.
segments.tr: - **pH do solo** — Uma medida da acidez ou alcalinidade do solo que controla a disponibilidade química dos nutrientes; a maioria das culturas tem melhor desempenho entre cerca de 6.0 e 7.0.

segments.src: - **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** — The soil's capacity to hold exchangeable positively charged nutrients on the negative surfaces of clay and humus; higher CEC means better nutrient retention.
segments.tr: - **Capacidade de troca catiônica (CTC)** — A capacidade do solo de reter nutrientes carregados positivamente trocáveis nas superfícies negativas da argila e do húmus; uma CTC mais alta significa melhor retenção de nutrientes.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — B.** Texture is set by the mineral particle sizes inherited from the parent material; changing it would require physically replacing enormous volumes of soil.
segments.tr: *Resposta: **Q1 — B.** A textura é definida pelos tamanhos das partículas minerais herdadas do material de origem; alterá-la exigiria substituir fisicamente volumes enormes de solo.

segments.src: Structure, pH, and CEC can all be shifted by tillage, lime, and organic matter.
segments.tr: A estrutura, o pH e a CTC podem ser alterados pelo preparo do solo, calcário e matéria orgânica.

segments.src: **Q2 — A.** Above roughly pH 7.5, iron converts to forms plants cannot absorb, so the deficiency is one of availability, not of quantity — this is called lime-induced chlorosis.
segments.tr: **Q2 — A.** Acima de aproximadamente pH 7.5, o ferro se converte em formas que as plantas não conseguem absorver, então a deficiência é de disponibilidade, não de quantidade — isso é chamado de clorose induzida por calcário.

segments.src: **Q3 — O.** About 25% water plus 25% air means roughly half the volume is pore space; the exact split shifts constantly as the soil wets and drains, but the total pore space stays about the same unless the soil is compacted.*
segments.tr: **Q3 — V.** Cerca de 25% de água mais 25% de ar significa que aproximadamente metade do volume é espaço poroso; a divisão exata muda constantemente à medida que o solo se molha e drena, mas o espaço poroso total permanece quase o mesmo, a menos que o solo seja compactado.*

in.title: [Pertanian 101 #3] Tanah Bukanlah Sekadar Debu: Mesin Empat Lapis di Bawah Kaki Anda

segments.src: > Soil is a living, layered structure made of mineral particles, organic matter, water, and air — and its texture, structure, and chemistry decide whether a seed becomes a harvest or a failure.
segments.tr: > Tanah adalah struktur berlapis yang hidup, terdiri dari partikel mineral, bahan organik, air, dan udara — serta tekstur, struktur, dan kimianya menentukan apakah benih akan menjadi panen atau kegagalan.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Grab a handful of soil from a backyard in Iowa or a raised bed in Brooklyn.
segments.tr: Ambil segenggam tanah dari halaman belakang di Iowa atau bedengan di Brooklyn.

segments.src: It looks like brown stuff.
segments.tr: Terlihat seperti benda berwarna cokelat.

segments.src: It is actually a four-part system, and a healthy topsoil is roughly:
segments.tr: Sebenarnya ini adalah sistem empat bagian, dan lapisan tanah atas yang sehat kira-kira terdiri dari:

segments.src: - **45% mineral particles** — ground-up rock
segments.tr: - **45% partikel mineral** — batuan yang digiling

segments.src: - **5% organic matter** — dead plants, roots, microbes, and the humus they become
segments.tr: - **5% bahan organik** — tanaman mati, akar, mikroba, dan humus yang terbentuk darinya

segments.src: That last number surprises people.
segments.tr: Angka terakhir itu mengejutkan banyak orang.

segments.src: A quarter of good soil is *empty space filled with air*.
segments.tr: Seperempat dari tanah yang baik adalah *ruang kosong yang diisi udara*.

segments.src: Roots breathe.
segments.tr: Akar bernapas.

segments.src: Drown out that air and the plant suffocates, which is exactly what happens in a waterlogged field.
segments.tr: Jika udara itu hilang, tanaman akan mati lemas, yang persis terjadi di lahan yang tergenang air.

segments.src: **Texture: the three-particle recipe.** Soil scientists sort mineral particles by size into three classes:
segments.tr: **Tekstur: resep tiga partikel.** Ilmuwan tanah mengelompokkan partikel mineral berdasarkan ukuran menjadi tiga kelas:

segments.src: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)
segments.tr: sand  = 0.05 – 2.0 mm   (gritty, you can feel individual grains)

segments.src: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)
segments.tr: silt  = 0.002 – 0.05 mm (smooth, like flour)

segments.src: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)
segments.tr: clay  = under 0.002 mm  (sticky when wet, hard when dry)

segments.src: The proportion of these three is **soil texture**, and it is essentially permanent — you cannot truck in enough sand to change a clay field.
segments.tr: Proporsi dari ketiganya adalah **tekstur tanah**, dan pada dasarnya bersifat permanen — Anda tidak bisa mengangkut cukup pasir untuk mengubah lahan tanah liat.

segments.src: Texture is read off the USDA soil textural triangle, which names 12 classes.
segments.tr: Tekstur dibaca dari segitiga tekstur tanah USDA, yang menamai 12 kelas.

segments.src: The most agriculturally famous is **loam** (roughly 40% sand, 40% silt, 20% clay): enough sand to drain, enough clay to hold water and nutrients.
segments.tr: Yang paling terkenal dalam pertanian adalah **loam** (kira-kira 40% pasir, 40% debu, 20% liat): cukup pasir untuk drainase, cukup liat untuk menahan air dan nutrisi.

segments.src: Why does particle size matter so much?
segments.tr: Mengapa ukuran partikel begitu penting?

segments.src: **Surface area.** A gram of sand has a few hundred square centimeters of surface.
segments.tr: **Luas permukaan.** Satu gram pasir memiliki luas permukaan beberapa ratus sentimeter persegi.

segments.src: A gram of clay has hundreds of *square meters*.
segments.tr: Satu gram liat memiliki ratusan *meter persegi*.

segments.src: Nutrients cling to particle surfaces, so clay holds nutrients and water; sand lets both run straight through.
segments.tr: Nutrisi menempel pada permukaan partikel, jadi liat menahan nutrisi dan air; pasir membiarkan keduanya langsung mengalir melewatinya.

segments.src: **Structure: how particles clump.** Texture is the ingredients; **structure** is how they're assembled.
segments.tr: **Struktur: bagaimana partikel menggumpal.** Tekstur adalah bahan-bahannya; **struktur** adalah bagaimana mereka disusun.

segments.src: Particles bind into crumbs and blocks called **aggregates** or **peds**, glued together by organic matter, fungal threads, and microbial secretions.
segments.tr: Partikel terikat menjadi remah dan blok yang disebut **agregat** atau **ped**, direkatkan oleh bahan organik, benang jamur, dan sekresi mikroba.

segments.src: Good structure — crumbly, cottage-cheese-like — creates two pore sizes at once: big pores that drain and admit air, small pores that hold water for roots.
segments.tr: Struktur yang baik — remah, seperti keju cottage — menciptakan dua ukuran pori sekaligus: pori besar yang mengalirkan air dan memasukkan udara, pori kecil yang menahan air untuk akar.

segments.src: Structure is fragile.
segments.tr: Struktur itu rapuh.

segments.src: Driving a heavy tractor over wet ground crushes it into **compaction**, and compacted soil resists both roots and rainfall.
segments.tr: Mengendarai traktor berat di atas tanah basah akan menghancurkannya menjadi **pemadatan**, dan tanah yang padat akan menahan akar dan air hujan.

segments.src: **The soil profile: reading the layers.** Dig a pit and you see **horizons**, labeled from the top:
segments.tr: **Profil tanah: membaca lapisan.** Gali lubang dan Anda akan melihat **horizon**, yang diberi label dari atas:

segments.src: - **O horizon** — surface litter, leaves and residue (thin or absent in tilled cropland)
segments.tr: - **Horizon O** — serasah permukaan, daun, dan residu (tipis atau tidak ada di lahan pertanian yang diolah)

segments.src: - **A horizon** — topsoil. Dark, organic-rich, where most roots and biology live. Often only 15–25 cm deep.
segments.tr: - **Horizon A** — tanah atas. Gelap, kaya organik, tempat sebagian besar akar dan biologi hidup. Seringkali hanya sedalam 15–25 cm.

segments.src: - **E horizon** — a leached, pale layer where clay and minerals have washed downward (not present in every soil)
segments.tr: - **Horizon E** — lapisan pucat yang tercuci, tempat liat dan mineral hanyut ke bawah (tidak ada di setiap tanah)

segments.src: - **B horizon** — subsoil. The accumulation zone, where clay and minerals washed down from above collect. Denser, lighter in color.
segments.tr: - **Horizon B** — tanah bawah. Zona akumulasi, tempat liat dan mineral yang hanyut dari atas terkumpul. Lebih padat, warnanya lebih terang.

segments.src: - **C horizon** — weathered parent material, barely altered rock fragments
segments.tr: - **Horizon C** — bahan induk yang lapuk, fragmen batuan yang hampir tidak berubah

segments.src: - **R horizon** — bedrock
segments.tr: - **Horizon R** — batuan dasar

segments.src: That top A horizon is the whole ballgame.
segments.tr: Horizon A teratas itulah yang paling menentukan.

segments.src: It takes centuries to build a few centimeters of it and one bad storm on bare ground to move it into a river.
segments.tr: Dibutuhkan waktu berabad-abad untuk membangun beberapa sentimeter lapisan itu dan satu badai buruk di tanah terbuka untuk memindahkannya ke sungai.

segments.src: **Chemistry: pH and the nutrient handshake.** Two chemical properties dominate.
segments.tr: **Kimia: pH dan jabat tangan nutrisi.** Dua sifat kimia mendominasi.

segments.src: **Soil pH** runs 0–14, and most crops prefer 6.0–7.0.
segments.tr: **pH tanah** berkisar 0–14, dan sebagian besar tanaman lebih menyukai 6.0–7.0.

segments.src: The reason is not that plants dislike acid — it's that pH controls nutrient *availability*.
segments.tr: Alasannya bukan karena tanaman tidak suka asam — tetapi karena pH mengontrol *ketersediaan* nutrisi.

segments.src: In acidic soil below about 5.5, phosphorus locks up with iron and aluminum, and aluminum itself becomes soluble enough to poison roots.
segments.tr: Di tanah asam di bawah sekitar 5.5, fosfor terkunci dengan besi dan aluminium, dan aluminium itu sendiri menjadi cukup larut untuk meracuni akar.

segments.src: Above 7.5, iron, zinc, and manganese become unavailable, which is why plants in alkaline soil yellow between the veins even though the iron is physically right there.
segments.tr: Di atas 7.5, besi, seng, dan mangan menjadi tidak tersedia, itulah sebabnya tanaman di tanah basa menguning di antara urat daun meskipun zat besinya ada di sana secara fisik.

segments.src: Farmers raise pH with agricultural lime and lower it with elemental sulfur.
segments.tr: Petani menaikkan pH dengan kapur pertanian dan menurunkannya dengan belerang elemental.

segments.src: **Cation exchange capacity (CEC)** is the soil's nutrient storage battery.
segments.tr: **Kapasitas tukar kation (KTK)** adalah baterai penyimpanan nutrisi tanah.

segments.src: Clay particles and humus carry negative surface charges, so they hold positively charged nutrients — calcium, magnesium, potassium, ammonium — and release them to roots on demand.
segments.tr: Partikel liat dan humus membawa muatan permukaan negatif, sehingga mereka menahan nutrisi bermuatan positif — kalsium, magnesium, kalium, amonium — dan melepaskannya ke akar sesuai kebutuhan.

segments.src: CEC is measured in centimoles of charge per kilogram.
segments.tr: KTK diukur dalam centimole muatan per kilogram.

segments.src: A sandy soil might sit at 3; a clay-and-humus soil at 25 or more.
segments.tr: Tanah berpasir mungkin berada di angka 3; tanah liat-dan-humus di angka 25 atau lebih.

segments.src: High CEC means fertilizer stays put.
segments.tr: KTK tinggi berarti pupuk tetap berada di tempatnya.

segments.src: Low CEC means it leaches out with the next rain, which is why sandy fields get fertilized in small, frequent doses rather than one big application.
segments.tr: KTK rendah berarti pupuk tercuci oleh hujan berikutnya, itulah sebabnya lahan berpasir diberi pupuk dalam dosis kecil dan sering daripada satu aplikasi besar.

segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.tr: Pikirkan perbedaan antara halaman rumput di pesisir New Jersey dan di Ohio tengah.

segments.tr: Halaman di pantai Jersey berada di atas tanah berpasir.

segments.tr: Air menghilang beberapa menit setelah hujan deras, sehingga rumput menguning dalam seminggu cuaca kering.

segments.tr: Solusinya bukan lebih banyak pupuk tetapi *lebih banyak bahan organik*: kompos meningkatkan kapasitas menahan air dan KTK, karena humus adalah salah satu bahan dengan KTK tertinggi di tanah.

segments.src: The Ohio lawn sits on heavy clay-loam.
segments.tr: Halaman di Ohio berada di atas tanah liat-loam yang berat.

segments.src: Opposite problems.
segments.tr: Masalah yang berlawanan.

segments.tr: Setelah hujan, genangan air bertahan selama sehari karena pori-porinya kecil dan drainasenya lambat.
